description: React Router 7 in framework mode on Vite 8, server-rendered through @react-router/express: route modules loaded on navigation, loaders and a zod-validated action that keep notes in a cookie session, React context state across routes, and a report route that reads the notes through a class with private fields and getters. @afterpack/vite protects both the client and the server build. The server-rendered page shows its content before it hydrates, so the app sets <main data-app-ready> once it has, and the smoke check and the scenarios wait for smoke.readySelector before they click.

build.note: react-router build runs the client and the server Vite builds; @afterpack/vite obfuscates each on generateBundle. AFTERPACK_E2E_DIST_DIR moves the baseline build beside it.

interactions.description: The server-rendered page hydrates; the counter increments on click.
